info.name: Job Portal API
info.description:
Job Portal Backend API - Job Seeker, Employer, Admin.

Run the folders in order 1 to 6. Postman stores the login cookie automatically, so each 'Login ...' request switches the active user. jobId, applicationId and seekerId are saved automatically by test scripts.

Authorization must be 'No Auth' - this API uses httpOnly cookies, not Bearer tokens.

request.description: Creates an EMPLOYER account. Password is hashed with bcrypt before saving.
Second employer, used later to prove ownership checks.
Creates a JOBSEEKER account.
ADMIN registration requires the adminSecret from .env, otherwise 403.
Proves that anyone cannot simply register themselves as ADMIN.
Email must be unique.
Sets the accessToken httpOnly cookie. Postman stores and resends it automatically.
bcrypt.compare fails, so login is rejected.
Any logged-in user. Reads the id from the JWT inside the cookie.
role, password, email and active cannot be changed here.
Logged in, but wrong role -> 403 from allowedRoles middleware.
postedBy is taken from the JWT, not from the body. Saves jobId as a collection variable.

item.name: Job Seeker tries to post a job (expect 403)

request.description: Run this AFTER logging in as the job seeker to see the 403.
No login needed. .populate() replaces the employer id with name/company/email.
Optional query filter.
Employer only. Filters by postedBy = logged-in employer.
Same role, different owner. Proves the ownership check works.
Saves applicationId as a collection variable.
Duplicate application prevention.
HIRED is not in the enum, so Mongoose validation rejects it.
Admin only. Saves the seeker id for the deactivate test.
Admin can delete a job they did not post. Its applications are deleted too.
Clears the accessToken cookie.
No cookie -> 401 from verifyToken.
